remarks: Welcome to your sunbathed oasis! This charming 2-bedroom, 1.5-bath townhouse offers the perfect blend of tranquility and convenience. Step into a large, updated kitchen featuring ample counter space, seamlessly flowing into a bright, airy, open-concept living and dining area-ideal for entertaining or relaxing. Upstairs, you'll find a spacious primary bedroom suite and a generous second bedroom, both bathed in natural light. The updated full bathroom adds a touch of modern comfort. Enjoy your morning coffee or host a BBQ on the inviting deck, perfect for warmer days. Just steps away from various restaurants and shopping, you'll have quick access to the train station, highways, and everything Stamford has to offer. This home truly embodies a lifestyle of ease and comfort! ***Please see Notes***ALL OFFERS WILL BE REVIEWED ON TUESDAY 3/25 @ 5 P.M.***
